stem: A 57-year-old woman reports loose stools containing undigested food for three years. She also has a dull abdominal ache that is relieved by warmth and by pressure, cold limbs, a constant feeling of cold, tiredness, and poor appetite. She has no lower back pain and the stools are not worse in the early morning. The tongue is pale, swollen, and wet with a thin white coating. The pulse is deep, weak, and slow. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 62-year-old woman reports a bearing-down sensation in the lower abdomen for two years, worse when standing for long periods or when tired. She has a sensation of something descending in the vagina, frequent urge to urinate, chronic loose stools, tiredness, and poor appetite. She has no bruising or abnormal bleeding and does not feel cold. The tongue is pale with a thin white coating. The pulse is weak. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 38-year-old woman reports easy bruising for eight months. She also has small purple spots on the legs, heavy periods with pale, watery blood, tiredness, poor appetite, loose stools, and a sallow complexion. The tongue is pale. The pulse is thin (thready) and weak. Which mechanism best explains her bleeding?

options.A: Heat in the Blood forcing it out of the vessels
options.C: Spleen Qi failing to hold Blood in the vessels
options.D: Empty Heat from Yin deficiency injuring the vessels

stem: A 30-year-old man reports epigastric and abdominal fullness for four days, beginning after a week of camping in steady rain during which he ate mostly cold, uncooked food. He also has a heavy sensation in the head and body, poor appetite, nausea, loose stools, a sweetish sticky taste in the mouth, and no thirst. The tongue has a thick, sticky white coating. The pulse is slippery and slow. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 39-year-old woman reports epigastric and abdominal fullness for ten days. She also has nausea, loose foul-smelling stools, thirst without a desire to drink, a heavy sensation in the body, a low-grade fever, and scanty dark urine. She has no hypochondriac pain, no bitter taste, and no genital itching or discharge. The tongue is red with a sticky (greasy) yellow coating. The pulse is slippery and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.B: Damp-Heat in the Liver and Gallbladder

stem: A 50-year-old man reports fatigue and poor appetite for five years. He also has loose stools, a persistent feeling of heaviness in the limbs, a muzzy (fuzzy) head, and mild abdominal fullness after meals. He does not feel cold and has no thirst. The tongue is pale and swollen with teeth marks and a sticky (greasy) white coating. The pulse is soggy (soft). Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?
In Spleen deficiency, failure of which Spleen function leads most directly to the formation of internal Dampness?

A 58-year-old man reports a weak, chronic cough for two years. He becomes slightly short of breath on exertion, has a weak voice and no desire to talk, sweats spontaneously during the day, and catches colds easily. His sputum is scant and watery. The tongue is pale with a thin white coating. The pulse is empty, most noticeably at the right front (Cun) position. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 44-year-old woman reports a dry cough for eight months, with scanty, sticky sputum that is occasionally streaked with blood. Her throat is dry and tickly, worse in the evening, and her voice has become hoarse. She has night sweats, a malar flush in the afternoon, and a feeling of heat in the palms and soles. The tongue is red and dry, with no coating. The pulse is thin (thready) and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 27-year-old woman reports a fever with slight aversion to cold that began two days ago. She has a sore, red, swollen throat, a cough with scanty yellow sputum, slight thirst, mild sweating and a headache. The tongue is slightly red on the tip and sides with a thin white coating. The pulse is floating and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 63-year-old man who is overweight reports a chronic cough for three years. He brings up profuse white, sticky sputum that is easy to expectorate, mostly in the morning. He feels oppression in the chest, becomes short of breath when lying flat, and has occasional nausea and a poor appetite. The tongue is swollen with a thick, sticky white coating. The pulse is slippery. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 51-year-old woman reports a loud, barking cough for ten days. It began after a cold, but she no longer has chills. She now coughs up profuse, thick, yellow-green sputum and has oppression in the chest, wheezing, a sensation of heat, thirst and restless sleep. The tongue is red and swollen with a thick, sticky yellow coating. The pulse is slippery and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 35-year-old man reports a dry cough for one week that began during a dry, windy autumn spell. He has scanty, sticky sputum that is hard to expectorate, a dry nose, dry lips, a dry throat, dry skin and slight thirst. He has no fever, night sweats or afternoon heat. The tongue is of normal color with a thin, dry coating. The pulse is slightly floating. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A patient has had a cough with thin, white sputum for one day, with marked aversion to cold, a slight fever, no sweating, a stuffy nose and aching in the body. Which pulse quality is most consistent with this presentation?

A 57-year-old man reports a chronic, dull lower backache with a feeling of cold in the back for four years. His knees and feet are always cold, he passes abundant clear urine and gets up twice at night to urinate, and he has low libido with impotence. He is tired and apathetic, with a bright-white complexion. The tongue is pale, swollen and wet. The pulse is deep, weak and slow. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 62-year-old woman reports a gradually worsening, low-pitched tinnitus for one year. She has dizziness, a sore and weak lower back and knees, poor memory, a dry mouth and throat at night, night sweats, constipation with dry stools and scanty dark urine. The tongue is red with no coating. The pulse is floating-empty and slightly rapid, weakest at both rear (Chi) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 3-year-old boy is brought in because he was late to sit, stand and walk and still speaks only a few words. His fontanelle closed late, his bones are soft and his teeth came in slowly. He is small for his age and his hair is sparse, but his appetite and stools are normal and his limbs are not cold. The tongue is pale with a thin white coating. The pulse is thin (thready) and weak. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 76-year-old woman reports urinary dribbling after voiding and occasional incontinence for two years. She urinates frequently, with pale urine and a weak stream, has a chronic thin, white vaginal discharge, and her lower back feels sore and weak. Her breathing is normal and she has no burning on urination. The tongue is pale. The pulse is deep and weak, especially at both rear (Chi) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 71-year-old man reports shortness of breath for six years that is worse on exertion. He finds it harder to breathe in than to breathe out, and he leaks urine when he coughs. He also has a sore lower back, cold limbs, spontaneous sweating and frequent clear urination. He has no edema and little sputum. The tongue is pale. The pulse is deep and weak, especially at both rear (Chi) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.C: Kidney Yang deficiency with water overflowing

stem: A 39-year-old man reports scanty dark urine with occasional blood for two months, without burning pain or urgency. He has a malar flush in the afternoon, heat in the palms and soles, night sweats, nocturnal emissions with dreams, a sore lower back and mental restlessness. The tongue is red, cracked and without coating. The pulse is floating-empty and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.A: Kidney Yin deficiency with Empty Fire
options.C: Full Heat in the Small Intestine

stem: A 69-year-old woman reports pitting edema of the ankles and lower legs for five months. She passes only small amounts of pale urine, her lower back and knees feel cold and sore, and her limbs are cold. She has palpitations and breathlessness on exertion and a feeling of fullness in the abdomen. The tongue is pale, swollen and wet, with a white coating. The pulse is deep, weak and slow. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.C: Kidney Yang deficiency with water overflowing

stem: A 49-year-old woman reports a dull, slightly burning epigastric discomfort for a year. She feels slightly hungry but has no desire to eat, feels full after small meals, and passes dry stools. Her mouth and throat are dry, especially in the afternoon, and she is thirsty but drinks only in small sips. The tongue is of normal color with a peeled patch in the center. The pulse is floating-empty at the right middle (Guan) position. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.D: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A 30-year-old man reports sudden, severe epigastric pain that began three hours after he had several iced drinks and a bowl of ice cream on a hot day. He has vomited clear, watery fluid, feels chilly, wants only warm drinks, and finds that a hot-water bottle eases the pain. He has no sour regurgitation or foul belching. The tongue has a thick white coating. The pulse is deep, slow and tight. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.B: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A 42-year-old woman reports epigastric fullness and pain for two days, beginning the night after a large holiday banquet. She has sour regurgitation, foul belching, nausea and a poor appetite, and the pain eases after she vomits. She has slept poorly, and her stools are loose and foul-smelling. The tongue has a thick, greasy coating. The pulse is full and slippery. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.A: Retention of Food in the Stomach

stem: A 34-year-old man reports diarrhea with mucus and blood for five days. He has abdominal pain that is not relieved by the bowel movement, urgency, foul-smelling stools and a burning sensation in the anus. He also has a low fever, a feeling of heaviness and scanty dark urine. The tongue is red with a sticky yellow coating. The pulse is slippery and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 29-year-old woman reports burning, painful urination with urgency and frequency for three days. Her urine is dark yellow and cloudy. She has a slight fever, a feeling of heaviness in the lower abdomen, and thirst without a desire to drink. She has no mouth ulcers or mental restlessness. The tongue has a thick, sticky yellow coating on the root. The pulse is slippery and rapid, especially at the left rear (Chi) position. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

options.A: Kidney Yin deficiency with Empty Fire
options.C: Full Heat in the Small Intestine

stem: Timidity, lack of courage and initiative, indecisiveness, being easily startled and frequent sighing, accompanied by a pale tongue and a weak pulse, are most characteristic of which pattern?

An 81-year-old woman reports constipation for two years, passing small, dry, pellet-like stools every three to four days with great difficulty. Her mouth, throat and skin are dry, she is thin, and she has occasional dizziness. She has no abdominal distension, anal burning or thirst for cold drinks. The tongue is pale and dry. The pulse is thin (thready). Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 37-year-old woman reports abdominal pain with loose stools for eighteen months. Episodes flare when she is stressed or angry, the pain eases after the bowel movement, and her stools alternate between loose and constipated. She also has abdominal distension, flatulence, irritability, tiredness and a poor appetite. The tongue is slightly red on the sides with a thin white coating. The pulse is wiry on the left and weak on the right. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 52-year-old woman reports insomnia for one year, with difficulty falling asleep and frequent waking. She has palpitations, mental restlessness, poor memory, dizziness, tinnitus, a sore lower back, night sweats, heat in the palms and soles, and scanty dark urine. The tongue is red with no coating and a redder tip. The pulse is rapid, weak at both rear (Chi) positions and relatively overflowing at both front (Cun) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 66-year-old man reports loose stools for two years, with urgent diarrhea just before dawn that contains undigested food. His abdomen and lower back feel cold, his limbs are cold, and he is tired with a poor appetite. He passes abundant clear urine and his ankles are slightly puffy. The tongue is pale, swollen, wet and teeth-marked. The pulse is deep, weak and slow. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 58-year-old woman reports dry, gritty eyes and blurred vision for two years. She also has dizziness, a low-pitched tinnitus, a sore and weak lower back and knees, numbness of the limbs, night sweats and a dry throat at night. She has no headache, irritability or palpitations. The tongue is red with no coating. The pulse is thin (thready) and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 61-year-old man reports a dry cough with occasional blood-streaked sputum for one year. He is breathless on exertion and has a hoarse voice, a dry throat at night, a sore lower back, night sweats, an afternoon malar flush and a thin body. The tongue is red and peeled. The pulse is thin (thready) and rapid, weakest at the right front (Cun) and both rear (Chi) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 45-year-old man reports fits of coughing for three weeks that are set off by arguments or frustration. He coughs up scanty, sticky yellow sputum, occasionally streaked with blood, and has pain in the chest and hypochondrium. He is irritable, with a red face, red eyes, a bitter taste and thirst. The tongue is red with redder sides and a dry yellow coating. The pulse is wiry and rapid. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?

A 12-year-old boy is brought in for a cough with thin, white, watery sputum that has persisted for two years and flares every winter. He is short of breath on exertion, has a weak voice, sweats easily and catches colds often. He also has a poor appetite, abdominal distension after eating, loose stools and tiredness. The tongue is pale and teeth-marked with a thin white coating. The pulse is weak, especially at the right front (Cun) and middle (Guan) positions. Which of the following is the most appropriate pattern diagnosis?
